note: Pre-registered before any v8 feature was compared with returns. Edit only while status is DRAFT. Once FROZEN, any change is a new version and restarts the paper-trading clock.
signal_timing: Friday close; trades at next trading day open

trained.features: sa_<input> for every dimension input (sign-adjusted cross-sectional z, coef >= 0) + extra_features (sign +1: coef >= 0, -1: <= 0, 0: free) + dim_<d> x macro_stress (free)

score_neutralization: demean within industry_twse per date (no risk-factor neutralization: risk is an intended dimension)

standard.engine: portfolio_sim.simulate_topk_twr (same engine as v7 Stage 3, for comparability)
standard.note: buffer_mult 10 keeps a held name while it ranks inside the top 200 (about the top 20%)

user_rules.buy_rule: each signal week buy the highest-scoring name with rank pct >= buy_pct that is below max_weight, amount = min(buy_amount_twd, cash); odd lots
user_rules.sell_rule: sell a holding when rank pct < sell_pct and it is in profit after costs (zero realized loss); proceeds return to cash
user_rules.industry_cap_rule: skip a candidate if (its industry_twse market value + this buy) / equity > industry_cap

benchmarks: 0050.TW lump-sum buy-and-hold, 100,000 TWD, dividends reinvested, same costs

evaluation.start: first Friday after status becomes FROZEN
evaluation.primary_endpoint: P1 standard portfolio weekly net return minus TW equal weight, 52 weeks: success iff mean > 0 and Newey-West t (4 lags) >= 2.0
secondary_endpoints: P1 weekly cross-sectional rank IC vs next-week open-to-open return, 26 and 52 weeks: mean > 0 and t >= 2.0
P1 user_rules net NAV return on the 100,000 TWD lump (cash included) vs hurdle 6% and vs 0050 lump-sum buy-and-hold
P2 and P3 reported with the same metrics (no arm switching)
evaluation.futility_stop: at 26 weeks, if P1 cumulative net excess vs EW < -10%, stop and recommend passive
evaluation.changes_allowed_while_frozen: data-pipeline bug fixes that do not change any definition above; each logged with date and reason
evaluation.adoption_rule: P1 may be used with real money only if ALL hold at 52 weeks: (1) primary endpoint passes; (2) P1 user_rules net NAV return >= 6% on 100,000 TWD (cash included, after all costs); (3) P1 user_rules net NAV return >= 0050 lump-sum buy-and-hold over the same 52 weeks. Otherwise the model is not adopted.

historical_oos.when: exactly once, after the FROZEN commit and before paper trading; logged in results/trial_log.csv; nothing may change afterwards
historical_oos.panel: snowball_tw_v8 built from the PIT panel (delisted names included, holdings that leave the universe valued at unmasked prices)
historical_oos.walkforward: expanding window; each refit uses only labels settled before the refit date (embargo 13 weeks); first refit once 104 signal weeks have settled labels; refit every 8 weeks; each model scores the following 8 weeks
comparators: v7_final on the PIT panel: cited from T2 (not re-run)
costs: odd-lot: round-lot costs + 0.3% slippage each side
historical_oos.small_capital_test: user_rules on 100,000 TWD lump with max_names in {5, 10, none}; descriptive sensitivity, not used to choose
historical_oos.gate: P1 standard portfolio, round-lot costs: Excess_t_NW (lags 4) >= 2.0 vs TW EW AND DSR >= 0.95 with N = trial_log rows at run time + 20; also report whether t >= 3.0 (Harvey, Liu & Zhu 2016)
historical_oos.if_gate_fails: stop active model development; no paper trading for adoption; engineering moves to passive core ETF tracking and the monthly investor report
report_metrics: max and current time under water (weeks)
net excess vs EW, Excess_t_NW, net IR, excess MDD
user_rules 100k: final NAV, net return, MDD, fees paid, vs 6% hurdle and vs 0050
rolling 3-year 6% HWM non-cumulative windows: P(any carry), P(every year >= 6%), mean manager share of profit (overlapping windows, descriptive)
